description: This file implements a POSIX-specific file enumerator class for traversing directories and files, including pattern matching and recursive traversal logic.

classes.name: FileEnumerator
classes.description: A class for enumerating files and directories with support for pattern matching and recursion.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next file path in the enumeration.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the current file.

classes.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo
classes.description: A structure holding information about a file, such as name, size, and modification time.

methods.name: IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file is a directory.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: GetLastModifiedTime
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of the file.

methods.name: GetStat
methods.description: Retrieves the stat information for a given path, following or not following symlinks based on show_links.

methods.name: IsPatternMatched
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the specified pattern.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if a file should be skipped during enumeration.

methods.name: IsTypeMatched
methods.description: Checks if a file's type matches the specified criteria.
